romans-10-study-notes.overview: This study note examines the reasons for Israel's rejection, the remedy for that rejection, and the resulting consequences for God's people. It explores the relationship between belief, obedience, and the message shared with the Gentiles.

romans-12-study-notes.overview: This study note explores the practical application of Romans 12, focusing on dedication, the nature of living sacrifice, and the relationships Christians should have with God and others. It details how to cultivate a transformed mind and will, and how to engage in honest self-evaluation and loving participation.

romans-08-study-notes.overview: This study note explores the four spiritual freedoms found in Romans 8, focusing on freedom from judgment, defeat, discouragement, and separation. It delves into the reality of suffering, the role of the Holy Spirit, and the ultimate hope found in God's perfect plan.
